therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: VEGFR kinase inhibition combined with PD-1 immune checkpoint blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor angiogenesis inhibition and T-cell activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Advanced alveolar soft part sarcoma and other soft tissue sarcomas

results.dose_information: Axitinib 5 mg twice daily (dose escalation 2-10 mg permitted), Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 21 days

context.duration: Up to 2 years treatment, up to 5 years follow-up
